title: Sanity check: D-001 past incident review cycle and owner

sheets.name: Places
rows: INR-4 names the security team and sets every quarter.
INR-3 calls the review a quarterly incident review.
The plan review row calls the trigger a quarterly incident review.
I-05 section 9, past incident review (line 131); D-001
The same row names the security team, led by the Security Operations Lead, as owner. It does not say who records the review.
Each incident_pattern_reviews entry holds date and summary only. A check of the reviewer needs a reviewed_by field.
inr-rpi-static allows a cycle of 92 days or less, and the reviewer check waits for DQ-001 and DQ-002. D-001 answers both.
G-010 and Q-006 ask which role runs and records the review. D-001 answers Q-006.
F-002 recommends keeping G-010 open until the owner and cycle are decided. D-001 decides them.
I-05 section 9, past incident review (line 131); D-001
The past incident review row sets at least every 90 days.

sheets.name: Follow-ups
rows: Change INR-4 to name the Security Operations Lead and to set at least every 90 days.
Call the trigger in INR-3 and in the plan review row the past incident review, so neither says quarterly.
POL-INR INR-3; plan section 9, plan review row
State in the past incident review row that the Security Operations Lead records each review.
Plan section 9, past incident review row
Add reviewed_by to each incident_pattern_reviews entry. Validator design DQ-003 also asks for incidents_covered and findings.
Record D-001 against DQ-001 and DQ-002, set the inr-rpi-static limit to 90 days, and compare reviewed_by with the Security Operations Lead.
Record D-001 as the answer to Q-006, and update G-010 and rewrite R-006 with the Security Operations Lead.
Note in F-002 that D-001 decided the owner and cycle.

sheets.name: Questions
rows: Who approves changes to the fields of the GRC records?
FU-04 needs an approver; the inputs do not name one
